extracted.intended_audience: hospital administrators, Medicare providers, health policy stakeholders, quality program managers, and public commenters
extracted.subtask_description: A Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services proposed rule setting FY2027 payment rates, policies, and quality program requirements for inpatient prospective payment systems (IPPS), LTCH PPS, related quality reporting programs, and payment models; solicits public comment on many specific measurement, payment, and regulatory criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Technology Add-on Payment — Newness Criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: A new technology must meet a 'newness' criterion to be eligible for a New Technology Add-on Payment (NTAP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears under 'New Technology Add-on Payment Criteria' alongside cost and substantial clinical improvement criteria; applications and evidence must demonstrate the technology is new for the NTAP period; CMS also describes an alternative inpatient NTAP pathway for certain transformative devices.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Technology Add-on Payment — Cost Criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant must show the new medical service or technology meets a cost criterion (i.e., has a cost that might not be adequately covered by existing MS-DRG payments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cost demonstration is required in NTAP applications; CMS lists cost as a distinct eligibility prong and discusses evaluation of cost in traditional and alternative pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Technology Add-on Payment — Substantial Clinical Improvement Criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: The technology must provide substantial clinical improvement compared to existing therapies to qualify for NTAP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS requires clinical evidence showing substantial improvement; discussed alongside newness and cost criteria and in evaluation of FY2027 candidate technologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative Pathway for New Technology Add-on Payments
rubrics_metrics.description: An alternative pathway exists for certain transformative devices and antimicrobial products to receive add-on payments with modified evidence or timing requirements (e.g., breakthrough devices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS describes alternative pathways (e.g., for breakthrough devices, certain antimicrobial products) and lists items like newness period and cost criterion considerations specific to the alternative pathway; specific device examples are listed with the pathway criteria (e.g., Bayesian Health Sepsis Flagging Device).

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of NTAP Applications and Eligibility Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS evaluates NTAP applications against explicit eligibility criteria (newness, cost, substantial clinical improvement) and provides application information and timelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes application information, public input before notice of rulemaking, ICD-10-PCS Section X codes, status updates of prior NTAP recipients, and proposed FY2027 applications by product.

rubrics_metrics.name: MS-DRG Classification and Reclassification Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed changes to MS-DRG classifications and reclassifications are based on coding system changes (ICD-10-CM/PCS) and clinical/administrative considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background, adoption steps, and specific MDC-level proposed changes, including examples (e.g., external heart assist systems, fluorescence-guided procedures), and basis for FY2027 updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Changes to ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS Coding Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to add, delete, or modify ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes that affect DRG assignment and severity levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposed additions/deletions to diagnosis severity levels, new section 'X' codes for certain services/technologies, and maintenance processes for coding systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Changes to Diagnosis Severity Levels and CC/MCC Lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed additions and deletions to condition severity levels (CC/MCC) and proposed CC exclusions, informed by comprehensive CC/MCC analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of conditions considered for severity-level changes include SDOH—homelessness/inadequate housing, newborn affected by malpresentation before labor, functional quadriplegia, malnutrition, prolonged first stage of labor; CMS describes analysis and proposed lists for FY2027.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recalibration of MS-DRG Relative Weights — Methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS recalibrates MS-DRG relative weights using defined data sources and a stated methodology including caps on relative weight reductions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS details data sources, general methodology, special relative weight calculation for certain MS-DRGs, cap for relative weight reductions, development of national average cost-to-charge ratios (CCRs), and steps used in recalibration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of National Average Cost-to-Charge Ratios (CCRs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Method for developing national average CCRs used in relative weight calculations and payment determinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS describes data sources and methodology for CCR development as part of relative weight recalibration and payment calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ICD-10-PCS Section X Codes Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of Section 'X' ICD-10-PCS codes for identifying certain new medical services and technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS proposes use of Section X codes to track and register certain new technologies and NTAP recipients, with crosswalks to payment considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: MS-DRG Surgical Hierarchies and Procedure Code Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to update surgical hierarchies and review procedure codes for specific MS-DRGs, including OR vs non-OR distinctions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background, proposed non-OR to OR reclassifications, and examples (e.g., pancreatic islet suspension introduction, percutaneous bone void filler introduction).

rubrics_metrics.name: Method for Computing the Unadjusted Wage Index
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS methodology for computing the proposed FY2027 unadjusted hospital wage index, including use of Worksheet S-3 wage data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS describes cost-report periods used, adjustments, and links to Worksheet S-3 data verification and correction processes; also discusses use by suppliers/providers other than acute care hospitals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worksheet S-3 Wage Data Verification and Corrections Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Processes and deadlines for hospitals to verify and request corrections to Worksheet S-3 wage data used in wage index calculation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS outlines verification of S-3 data, the process for hospitals to request corrections, and CMS-initiated corrections after the public use file release date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Occupational Mix Adjustment to the Wage Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed occupational mix adjustment methodology using Medicare Wage Index Occupational Mix Survey results (e.g., 2022 survey for FY2027).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS details calculation of the occupational mix adjustment, deadlines for future surveys, and its incorporation into the FY2027 wage index.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hospital Redesignation and Reclassification Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and policies for hospital urban-to-rural reclassification, Lugar status determinations, and MGCRB reclassification effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals include application requirements, proposed regulatory revisions (e.g., addressing ferry routes), clarifications about data used for reclassification, waivers for wage data comparisons, and treatment of dual-reclassified hospitals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wage Index Adjustment Policies (Rural Floor, Imputed Floor, State Frontier Floor, Out-Migration, Caps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed policies for wage index adjustments including Rural Floor, Imputed Floor, State Frontier Floor, out-migration adjustments, cap on wage index decreases, and transition policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides descriptions of each adjustment, proposed FY2027 tables, labor-related share proposals, and budget-neutrality implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Empirically Justified Medicare DSH Payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria determining eligibility for empirically justified Medicare Disproportionate Share Hospital (DSH) and uncompensated care payments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS explains general eligibility, supplemental payments for IHS/tribal/Puerto Rico hospitals, and the structure of uncompensated care payment calculation using Factors 1, 2, and 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncompensated Care Payment — Factor 1 Calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodology for calculating Factor 1 in the uncompensated care payment formula for FY2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides detailed proposed calculation steps for Factor 1 as part of the uncompensated care payment determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncompensated Care Payment — Factor 2 Calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodology for calculating Factor 2 in the uncompensated care payment formula for FY2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background and proposed Factor 2 calculations, including data sources and formula elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncompensated Care Payment — Factor 3 Calculation and Methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed methodology for calculating Factor 3, including scaling factor, new hospital policy, newly merged hospital policy, CCR trim methodology, and uncompensated care data trim methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS outlines steps for Factor 3 calculation, per-discharge amounts, methodologies for mergers and reconciliation, and processes for hospitals to notify CMS of merger updates and upload issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Low-Volume Hospital Payment Adjustment Criteria and Application Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for low-volume hospital payment adjustments, temporary changes extension, definition changes, payment adjustment methodology, and process to request and obtain the adjustment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background, extension of temporary changes, specifics for the portion of FY2027 beginning Jan 1, 2027, and procedural steps for requesting the adjustment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medicare-Dependent, Small Rural Hospital (MDH) Program Policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing MDH program eligibility, implementation of legislative extensions, and expiration handling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background on MDH, implementation of statutory changes, and timelines for program application and expiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Requirements to Prohibit Unlawful Discrimination in GME and Nursing/Allied Health Education Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to prohibit unlawful discrimination in approved medical residency, nursing, and allied health education programs and to update accreditation standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposed modification to criteria for new residency programs (e.g., initial accreditation, removal of restrictions on experienced faculty, requirements for new residents, exceptions for certain resident categories and small programs), proposals for nursing/allied health programs, and links to prior FY2025 proposals and responses to comment solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for New Residency Program Approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed criteria for approval of new residency programs including accreditation expectations, staffing/faculty considerations, resident requirements, and exceptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS discusses initial accreditation, proposed removal of restrictions on experienced faculty and staff, proposed requirement for new residents, proposed exceptions for certain categories of residents and small programs, and references to prior rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calculating Direct GME and IME Payments Following Hospital Mergers
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodology for calculating Direct GME (DGME) and Indirect Medical Education (IME) payments following hospital mergers, including pre- and post-merger payment periods and subsequent cost reporting periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details include IRB ratio numerator/denominator, IRB ratio cap, DRG revenue and total IME payment calculations, and examples for specific fiscal periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Closure and Available Residency Slot Application Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for notifying CMS of a teaching hospital closure and for applying to available residency slots (e.g., example hospital closures and rounds).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background, specific closure notices, and the application process for available resident slots (Round 27, Round 28 examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonable Cost Payment Policies for Nursing and Allied Health Education Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Regulatory changes and clarifications for determining net cost of approved nursing and allied health education activities, including identification of allowable indirect (overhead) costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS discusses overview of existing regulations, litigation and rulemaking history, determination of net cost (§413.85(d)(2)(i) and (ii)), and identification/allocation of allowable indirect costs and overhead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program — Measure Adoption and Specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed adoption of specific readmission measures (e.g., 30-day all-cause risk-standardized readmission rate following sepsis) with detailed measure specifications: numerator, denominator, risk adjustment, reliability testing, calculation of excess readmission ratio, payment reductions, and data submission/public reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides measure background, overview, full measure specifications (including calculation steps), PRMR and endorsement history, and implications for payment reductions and public reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (VBP) Program — Measures and Performance Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of VBP measures, FY2027 payment details, baseline and performance period definitions, and performance standard setting for program years FY2028–FY2032.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS includes summaries of previously adopted quality measures, newly established performance standards for certain upcoming program years, background on baseline and performance periods, and payment methodology details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hospital-Acquired Condition (HAC) Reduction Program Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Program criteria, measures, and policies for the HAC Reduction Program affecting hospital payment adjustments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a distinct program section; CMS provides background and cross-references to measure selection and scoring policies (details in the body of the rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection Considerations for Hospital Inpatient Quality Reporting (IQR) Measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations CMS uses to expand and update IQR measures including measure importance, feasibility, burden, and evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS outlines background and history of IQR program, considerations for expanding/updating measures, and the process for pre-rulemaking review and endorsement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed New Measures for Hospital IQR — Measure Specification Components
rubrics_metrics.description: When proposing new IQR measures (e.g., Excess Days in Acute Care after hospitalization for diabetes; Hospital Harm—Postoperative VTE eCQM), CMS sets out measure background, numerator/denominator, risk-adjustment, PRMR/endorsement, data sources, submission, and public reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each proposed measure entry contains the same specification structure: background, overview, calculation (numerator/denominator/risk-adjustment), pre-rulemaking endorsement status, data source and submission instructions, and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Removals and Modifications to IQR Measure Set
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS proposes removal of specific measures (e.g., two VTE eCQMs, Discharged on Antithrombotic Therapy measure beginning FY2030) and modifications to existing measures (e.g., updates to Excess Days in Acute Care measures), including rationale and technical updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background, overview of proposed updates, measure calculations, pre-rulemaking endorsement history, submission/reporting impacts, and planned technical updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form, Manner, and Timing of Quality Data Submission — eCQM Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed updates to eCQM reporting and submission requirements, including mandatory reporting proposals for specific eCQMs, certification/file format requirements, zero denominator declarations, case threshold exemptions, and submission deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS proposes mandatory reporting of measures such as the Malnutrition Care Score and Hospital Harm eCQMs, outlines technical specifications maintenance, eCQM certification requirements, file formats, and proposed submission deadlines and review/corrections periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: PPS-Exempt Cancer Hospital (PCH) Quality Reporting Program — eCQM Reporting Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed new measures, removals (e.g., COVID-19 vaccination coverage among HCP), and proposed updates to eCQM reporting requirements for PPS-exempt cancer hospitals including certification, file format, zero denominator declarations, case threshold exemptions, and submission deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS details the PCH measure set changes, data submission and reporting requirements, and review/correction periods specifically for the PCH QRP.

rubrics_metrics.name: LTCH PPS Classification Criteria and Limitation on Charges
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for classification as a Long-Term Care Hospital (LTCH), hospitals excluded from the LTCH PPS, and limits on beneficiary charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS discusses statutory/regulatory authority, classification tests, exclusions, and limitation policies for beneficiaries, as well as proposed MS-LTC-DRG classification changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: MS-LTC-DRG Relative Weights Development Steps
rubrics_metrics.description: A 11-step (enumerated as Step 1–Step 11) methodology for preparing data and calculating MS-LTC-DRG relative weights, including outlier removal, quintile establishment, charge adjustments, iterative calculation, monotonicity adjustments, handling MS-LTC-DRGs with no applicable cases, budget neutrality, and application of a 10-percent cap on decreases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS spells out each procedural step (e.g., remove cases with LOS ≤7 days, establish low-volume quintiles, remove outliers, adjust charges for SSOs) and subsequent budget-neutralization steps and caps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed LTCH PPS Payment Rate and Market Basket Update Methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the development of proposed standard federal payment rates for LTCH PPS, including proposed annual updates tied to the market basket and quality reporting adjustments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposed FY2027 LTCH standard federal payment rate update, adjustment under LTCH QRP, and market basket methodology descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crosscutting Quality Program Proposal — Advance Care Planning eCQM Adoption
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to adopt the Advance Care Planning electronic clinical quality measure across multiple programs (Hospital IQR, PCH QRP, Medicare Promoting Interoperability), including measure calculation and data submission expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background, overview, calculation instructions, PRMR/endorsement status, and data sources/submission mechanisms for the measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Rulemaking Measure Review and Endorsement (PRMR) Considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the Pre-Rulemaking Measure Review (PRMR) process recommendations and measure endorsement status to inform adoption or modification of measures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS cites PRMR recommendations and endorsement as part of the measure adoption process across programs and as material for requesting public comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policies Regarding Public Display of Measure Data
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to modify public display of quality measure data (e.g., to end public display of certain COVID-19 vaccination coverage measures for HCP and patients/residents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides background and justification for ending public display of specific measures and solicits comment on the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program — Objectives, Measures, and Scoring Methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of objectives/measures, scoring methodology, proposed ONC Health IT Certification updates, and proposals to add/remove measures or attestations (e.g., remove ONC Direct Review, remove certain referral loop measures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background on statutory authority, proposals to modify electronic prior authorization measure (make it a bonus then required), ONC certification criteria to support measures, possible future performance-based measures, and clinical quality measurement reporting expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal to Adopt Unique Device Identifier (UDI) Measure for Implantable Devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to adopt a UDI for Implantable Devices measure in the Promoting Interoperability program's Public Health and Clinical Data Exchange Objective, with options for future performance-based use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS discusses background, proposed start (CY2027), requests for information on future directions and additional UDI options, and potential scoring implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview and Selection of Quality Measures for Proposed Payment Models (TEAM, CJR-X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for episode definitions, attribution, selection of quality measures, baseline/performance period methodologies, composite quality score construction, quality improvement expectations, and application of quality scores to payment reconciliation in models like TEAM and CJR-X.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS details proposed changes for episodes (e.g., spinal fusion), proposed measure performance periods, selection and scoring of proposed quality measures for CJR-X, composite quality score calculation and use in reconciliation and discount/adjustment of payments, with procedural safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: CJR-X Model — Episode Scope, Items/Services Inclusion, and Exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions for episode initiation, items and services included or excluded from an episode, episode duration, termination criteria, and clinical episode identification (LEJR, MS-DRG/HCPCS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides detailed scope definitions, examples of included/excluded items, episode identification rules, and special handling for episodes spanning performance years.

rubrics_metrics.name: CJR-X Pricing and Payment Methodology — Target Prices, Risk Adjustment, and Reconciliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodology for setting preliminary and reconciliation target prices, baseline period selection for benchmarking, regional target price calculation, trending, discount factors, outlier caps, risk adjustment/normalization, reconciliation timing and processes, and limits on NPRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on constructing target prices, special considerations for low-volume hospitals, applying composite quality score to reconciliation, calculating raw NPRA, limitations, participant responsibility for increased post-episode payments, and reconciliation payments/repayments procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Appeals Process for Payment Reconciliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed notice of calculation error and reconsideration request process for participants seeking review of reconciliation calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS outlines appeals steps, timing, and procedures related to reconciliation notices and reconsideration requests within CJR-X/T.E.A.M. and similar payment models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposals for Measure Technical Maintenance and Reporting Burden Reduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to maintain technical specifications, update eCQM reporting mechanisms, modify measure reporting deadlines, and reduce unnecessary provider burden while ensuring data quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS proposes technical updates, revised submission deadlines (e.g., for LTCH QRP), certification/file format changes, and review/correction periods to balance reporting integrity and provider burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal to Remove or Modify Specified Measures (e.g., COVID-19 HCP Vaccination Measures)
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS proposes removing or ending the public display of certain pandemic-era measures and revising measure sets to reflect current priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific proposals include removing COVID-19 vaccination coverage measures from LTCH QRP and PCH QRP beginning FY2028 and related public display proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical and Statistical Methodologies for Measure Calculation (Numerator/Denominator/Risk Adjustment/Reliability Testing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard components CMS requires when specifying quality/performance measures: clear numerator and denominator definitions, risk adjustment approaches, measure calculation methods, and reliability testing procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These components are repeatedly specified across adopted and proposed measures (e.g., sepsis readmission measure, mortality measures, excess days measures) and are accompanied by PRMR/endorsement documentation and technical specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Source, Submission, and Public Reporting Requirements for Quality Measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification of acceptable data sources, formats, submission mechanisms (e.g., eCQM files), deadlines, zero-denominator handling, and public reporting/display rules for measures across programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS sets program-specific submission requirements (Hospital IQR, PCH QRP, LTCH QRP, Promoting Interoperability), including certification requirements for eCQM reporting and proposed changes to timing and form of submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and Corrections Period for eCQM Data Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: A review and corrections window for eCQM data submitted to program portfolios, with procedures and deadlines for hospitals to correct submissions before final reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed for PCH and other programs: CMS proposes specific review/correction periods and processes to ensure data accuracy prior to public reporting or payment determinations.
